methodology.query_origin: Independently agent-authored and independently audited synthetic queries; not human annotations or real-user traffic.
methodology.development_scope: The old66 query set was visible during v2 development and tuning; do not call it held out.
methodology.holdout_scope: New query wording and labels were withheld until all evaluated configurations froze. Indexed documents remain available normally.
methodology.label_semantics: Any listed direct-answer page is useful; alternatives are not exhaustive set recall.
methodology.metrics: Hit@1, Hit@k, MRR@k on positives; negative refusal and false positives separately; no calibrated relevance probability.
methodology.timing_scope: Cold means fresh process, not cleared filesystem cache. Native output is compact paths; Python includes richer metadata. Warm timings include pipe/JSON overhead.
methodology.memory_scope: Per-target wait4 RSS from a fresh minimal stdlib helper. This avoids fork-inherited RSS inflation from the large evaluator. Original normal-process wall timings are preserved; separate isolated memory profiles are recorded. Not aggregate process-tree RSS; semantic hybrid also retains a native lexical child.
methodology.selection: Metrics support comparison on this synthetic set; using them to choose a default is model selection, not a new unseen acceptance test.

python.description: Original unchanged Python CLI, including rich signatures/snippets/metadata.

native_v1.description: Unmodified first-round binary and index, archived before v2 edits.

native_tree.description: Optional frozen CPU tree ranker on the shared native candidates.

semantic_dense.description: Optional offline CPU semantic route, mode=dense.

semantic_dense_unfiltered.description: Fixed ungated semantic ranking diagnostic; no threshold tuning on the holdout.

development.purpose: Independent manually authored synthetic query-holdout, not document-holdout or real-user traffic; not training data.
